tools.name: SearchObject
tools.description: [read-only] Find, search, locate, or check if an ABAP repository object exists by name or wildcard pattern (e.g. 'ZOK*'). Use this tool to answer questions like 'is there a program named...', 'find all objects starting with...', 'does this class exist?', 'list objects matching...'. Supports all repository object types — optionally filter by type (PROG, CLAS, INTF, DEVC, TABL, DDLS, DTEL, FUGR, SRVD, SRVB, BDEF, DDLX, etc.).

maxResults.description: [read-only] Maximum number of results to return

tools.name: GetInclude
tools.description: [read-only] Retrieve source code of a specific ABAP include file. Class includes — names padded with '=' and ending in CCIMP, CCDEF, CCMAC or CCAU — are not standalone includes; this path answers HTTP 500 for them and the tool now refuses them up front. Read local types and the implementations include with GetLocalTypes, local definitions with GetLocalDefinitions, macros with GetLocalMacros, the test include with GetLocalTestClass. All four are exposed on the development tool surface (toolSurface: development), not on readonly.

tools.name: GetInactiveObjects
tools.description: [read-only] Get a list of inactive ABAP objects — modified but not yet activated, pending activation. Shows classes, tables, CDS views, and other objects awaiting activation. Takes no arguments and reports the whole system, so an empty result means "nothing anywhere is inactive" — which is also what a system returns for an object that was never created. An empty result is therefore not evidence that a particular object activated; read that object back to confirm.

tools.name: GrepObjects
tools.description: [read-only] Search ABAP source code for a regex pattern across multiple named objects in a single call — finds matching lines (with optional context) instead of reading each object one by one. Supports CLAS, PROG, INTF, INCL, and FUGR (function group). Individual function modules (FUNC) are not supported; use FUGR with the group name to search the whole group. Matching is case-sensitive unless case_insensitive is true — 0 matches means "this pattern found nothing", not "the code is absent". CLAS searches source/main only: local types and the implementations include (CCIMP, where behavior-pool handlers and local classes live) are not scanned and no skipped entry is written for them; read those with GetLocalTypes. FUGR is expanded to the group's function modules and includes (each reported under its own name); if the group cannot be expanded, the reason is listed under skipped instead of a silent 0. GrepObjects reads the active version — before reading 0 matches as "the source does not contain it", check GetInactiveObjects: a pending inactive version is not scanned. After FUGR expansion at most 200 objects are scanned per call; a group that would exceed that cap is listed under skipped with its member count instead of being scanned partially.

object_type.description: ABAP object type: CLAS, PROG, INTF, INCL, or FUGR.

pattern.description: JavaScript regular expression source to search for (e.g. "SELECT\\s+\\*").

context_lines.description: Number of lines of context before/after each match (0-5). Default: 0.

max_results.description: Maximum total matches to return across all objects. Default: 100.

tools.name: CheckSyntax
tools.description: [read-only] Run a standalone ABAP syntax check WITHOUT writing anything to SAP. Supports 'class', 'program', 'interface', 'include', and 'function_module'. If source_code is provided (class/program/interface only), the proposed source is compiled in place and checked without touching the server. If source_code is omitted, checks whatever is currently staged as the inactive version on the server (mirroring the post-write check Update* handlers run). Syntax errors are returned as normal results, not as tool errors — only connection/infra failures are reported as errors. For 'include', pass main_program (the program that INCLUDEs it) to compile the include inside that program's tree — main plus all includes, inactive version; without it SAP may return no verdict at all, which is reported as success: null with verdict: "indeterminate" (not as a failure). Every response carries verdict: "clean" | "errors" | "indeterminate". source_code is copied into the tool call, so a very large source (around 100 KB and up) can arrive truncated and the error then points at the cut-off line rather than at a real problem: check only the changed statements in a small program, and after writing, check the stored version without source_code. An 'INCLUDE report ... not found' error right after writing that include in the same session is not trustworthy: run ReloadProfile and check again (it has come back clean in a fresh session; cause unknown).

object_type.description: [read-only] ABAP object kind to check: 'class' (CLAS), 'program' (PROG), 'interface' (INTF), 'include' (PROG/I), or 'function_module' (FUGR/FF).

object_name.description: [read-only] Name of the object to check (e.g., ZCL_MY_CLASS).

function_group_name.description: [read-only] Function group name. Required when object_type is 'function_module'.

source_code.description: [read-only] Optional proposed ABAP source code to check in place. Only honored for object_type 'class', 'program', or 'interface' — ignored for 'include' and 'function_module' (see description).

main_program.description: [read-only] For object_type 'include' only: name of the main program that INCLUDEs it. When given, the include is compiled inside that program's tree (inactive version) so the check has a real verdict.

tools.name: GetSourceDiff
tools.description: [read-only] Compute a unified diff between the source code of two ABAP objects (e.g. compare ZCL_A vs ZCL_B, or a program vs a copy of itself). Supports CLAS, PROG, INTF, INCL. If the two sources differ too extensively to safely diff (after trimming common leading/trailing lines), returns { identical: false, too_large: true, reason, stats: { old_lines, new_lines } } instead of a diff.

object_type_a.description: Object type of the first (left / "old") object.

object_name_a.description: Object name of the first (left / "old") object.

object_type_b.description: Object type of the second (right / "new") object.

object_name_b.description: Object name of the second (right / "new") object.

context_lines.description: Number of unchanged context lines around each change.

tools.name: GetClass
tools.description: Retrieve ABAP class source code. Supports reading active or inactive version. Optionally append a compressed dependency context (public signatures of referenced classes/interfaces) via with_context.

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) for deployed version, "inactive" for modified but not activated version.

with_context.description: If true, append a "dependency_context" field with compressed public contracts (signatures) of every class/interface referenced by this class, so callers get surrounding context in one call. Function modules referenced via CALL FUNCTION are noted but not resolved. Default false.

context_max_deps.description: Max number of dependencies to resolve when with_context is true (1-15). Default 10.

tools.name: GetFunctionModule
tools.description: Retrieve ABAP function module definition. Supports reading active or inactive version. CAUTION: the default version='active' returns the pre-edit source when an unactivated edit exists — writing on top of it silently destroys the previous edit and no gate catches it. When re-editing, read version='inactive' first (or check GetInactiveObjects), and re-read after every write. A returned 'active' source is NOT proof the FM was ever successfully activated (never-activated FMs also return it).

function_group_name.description: FunctionGroup name containing the function module (e.g., Z_MY_FUNCTIONGROUP).

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) for deployed version, "inactive" for modified but not activated version.

check_inactive.description: When reading the active version, also read the inactive version (one extra ADT call) and, if an unactivated version exists and its source differs, attach a 'warning' to the response. Default true. The extra read never fails or slows the main read. Set false to skip it.

tools.name: UpdateClass
tools.description: Update source code of an existing ABAP class. Locks, checks, updates, unlocks, and optionally activates.

transport_request.description: Transport request number (e.g., E19K905635). Required for transportable packages.

activate.description: Activate after update. Default: false.

tools.name: UpdateSourceByPatch
tools.description: Modify existing ABAP source code on SAP via a surgical string replacement (find old_string, replace with new_string) instead of resending the full source. Fetches the current source, applies the patch, then delegates the write to the same lock -> syntax-check -> update -> unlock -> (activate) flow used by UpdateClass/UpdateProgram/UpdateInterface/UpdateInclude/UpdateFunctionModule. Supported object_type values: CLAS (class), PROG (program, on-premise/legacy only), INTF (interface), INCL (include, on-premise/legacy only), FUNC (function module, requires function_group). old_string must match the current source exactly, including whitespace, and must be unique unless replace_all is true. Reads the inactive version first and falls back to the active one (source_version_read in the response says which), so consecutive activate:false patches no longer overwrite each other. Line endings are normalized for matching (multi-line old_string works on CRLF sources) and the source's own line ending is restored on write. A non-unique old_string is rejected with the line number and text of every match; set match_whole_line to require whole-line matches. Function-group includes (L<group>TOP, L<group>F01, ...) are written through the function-group include address. An existing inactive version may contain edits you did not make (another user's abandoned draft) — source_version_read tells you which version was patched, and activate:true activates that whole version, draft included.

object_type.description: ABAP object kind to patch: CLAS (class), PROG (program), INTF (interface), INCL (include), FUNC (function module).

object_name.description: Name of the object to patch (e.g., ZCL_MY_CLASS).

function_group.description: Function group name. Required when object_type is 'FUNC'.

old_string.description: Exact text to find in the current source (whitespace-sensitive). Must match exactly once unless replace_all is true.

replace_all.description: Replace every occurrence of old_string instead of requiring a unique match. Default: false.

match_whole_line.description: Require every line of old_string to match a whole source line (leading/trailing whitespace ignored) instead of a substring match. Use it when a short anchor is also part of another statement (FORM x. inside PERFORM x.) or differs only by indentation. Default: false.

transport_request.description: Transport request number, passed through to the delegated update handler.

activate.description: Activate the object after the patched source is written. Default: false.

tools.name: ActivateObjects
tools.description: [high-level] Activate a set of ABAP objects in a single call. Uses the ADT mass-activation endpoint (/sap/bc/adt/activation/runs) so cyclic references between siblings (e.g. main program + multiple cross-referencing includes) resolve in one compilation scope. Returns per-object status, errors, warnings. Falls back to /sap/bc/adt/activation on legacy systems. FUGR recipe: activating function modules alone fails with 'FUNCTION ... cannot be used outside a FUNCTION-POOL' — pass the whole family in ONE run: the function group (type FUGR), its TOP include (FUGR/I with parent_name), every function module (FUGR/FF with parent_name), and the SAPL<group> main program (PROG/P) when present. Do NOT include the system include L<group>UXX. Never mix unrelated objects into the same activation run — activate only the object family being worked. The returned success/activated flags mirror the activation-run response and are NOT proof of activation on their own — confirm by re-querying GetInactiveObjects (your objects absent from the list = actually activated). When the run reports activationExecuted=false and checkExecuted=false, nothing was activated regardless of the per-object entries: success is false, run_executed is false and every object carries status 'not_executed' (REPOSRC.R3STATE stays 'I' even though GetInactiveObjects may not list the object). Do not retry such a run — rewrite the full source with UpdateInclude (main_program set) or UpdateClass, activate:true, which has cleared this state in practice.

type.description: ADT object type code, e.g. 'PROG/P' (program), 'PROG/I' (include), 'CLAS/OC' (class), 'FUGR/FF' (function module).

uri.description: Explicit ADT URI. When provided, overrides name-based URI resolution.

parent_name.description: Parent name — required for FUGR/FF (function group) and FUGR/I (function-group include).

objects.description: Objects to activate in one batch. Supply either explicit uri, or name+type (and parent_name for FUGR/FF, FUGR/I).

preaudit.description: Request pre-audit before activation. Default true.

run_timeout_ms.description: Max time to wait for the activation run to finish (runs endpoint only). Default 120000.

tools.name: GetTable
tools.description: Retrieve ABAP table definition. Supports reading active or inactive version.

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) for deployed version, "inactive" for modified but not activated version.

tools.name: GetStructure
tools.description: Retrieve ABAP structure definition. Supports reading active or inactive version.

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) for deployed version, "inactive" for modified but not activated version.

tools.name: GetSqlQuery
tools.description: [read-only] Execute ABAP SQL SELECT queries on database tables and CDS views via SAP ADT Data Preview API. Use for ad-hoc data retrieval, row counts, and filtered queries. Empty cells (including self-closing XML cells) are preserved as null in row order. Complex statements (e.g. 4-way joins, long IN lists) can fail with HTTP 400 — shorten table aliases or replace a long IN list with a BETWEEN range; a sporadic 400 (e.g. under concurrent calls) is retried once automatically. The response also reports returned_row_count (rows actually parsed), truncated (true when the row_number cap was hit or the server total exceeds it), and server_total_rows (server-reported total when the XML provides it).

row_number.description: [read-only] Maximum number of rows to return

acknowledge_risk.description: Set to true ONLY after the user has explicitly authorized row extraction from an 'ask'-tier protected table. The approval is logged to stderr for audit. Has no effect on 'deny'-tier tables.

tools.name: GetInstalledComponents
tools.description: [read-only] Retrieve installed software components with release/support-package level (e.g. SAP_BASIS 757 SP02). Returns { supported: false } instead of an error when the underlying ADT endpoint is absent on this release.

tools.name: DescribeByList
tools.description: [read-only] Batch description for a list of ABAP objects. Input: objects: Array<{ name: string, type?: string }>. Each object may be of type: PROG/P, FUGR, PROG/I, CLAS/OC, FUGR/FC, INTF/OI, TABLE, STRUCTURE, etc.

name.description: [read-only] Object name (required, must be valid ABAP object name or mask)

tools.name: GetAbapAST
tools.description: [read-only] Parse ABAP code and return AST (Abstract Syntax Tree) in JSON format.

filePath.description: Optional file path to write the result to

tools.name: GetAbapSemanticAnalysis
tools.description: [read-only] Perform semantic analysis on ABAP code and return symbols, types, scopes, and dependencies.

filePath.description: Optional file path to write the result to

tools.name: GetAbapSystemSymbols
tools.description: [read-only] Resolve ABAP symbols from semantic analysis with SAP system information including types, scopes, descriptions, and packages.

code.description: ABAP source code to analyze and resolve symbols for

filePath.description: Optional file path to write the result to

tools.name: GetObjectInfo
tools.description: [read-only] Return ABAP object tree structure for packages (DEVC), classes (CLAS), programs (PROG), function groups (FUGR), and other objects. Shows root, group nodes, and terminal leaves up to maxDepth. Enrich each node with description and package via SearchObject if enrich=true.

parent_type.description: [read-only] Parent object type (e.g. DEVC/K, CLAS/OC, PROG/P)

maxDepth.description: [read-only] Maximum tree depth (default depends on type)

enrich.description: [read-only] Whether to add description and package via SearchObject (default true)

tools.name: GetObjectStructure
tools.description: [read-only] Retrieve ADT object structure as a compact JSON tree. If no top-level node of the returned tree is the requested object, the text starts with a line beginning "WARNING:" — the structure service probably does not support that object type and answered with an unrelated tree, which must not be read as the structure of the requested object.

tools.name: GetPackageTree
tools.description: [high-level] Retrieve complete package tree structure including subpackages and objects. Returns hierarchical tree with object names, types, and descriptions.

package_name.description: Package name (e.g., "ZMY_PACKAGE")

include_subpackages.description: Include subpackages recursively in the tree. If false, subpackages are shown as first-level objects but not recursively expanded. Default: true

max_depth.description: Maximum depth for recursive package traversal. Default: 5

include_descriptions.description: Include object descriptions in response. Default: true

debug.description: Include diagnostic metadata in response (counts, types, hierarchy info). Default: false

tools.name: GetSession
tools.description: [read-only] Get a new session ID and current session state (cookies, CSRF token) for reuse across multiple ADT operations. Use this to maintain the same session and lock handle across multiple requests.

force_new.description: Force creation of a new session even if one exists. Default: false

tools.name: GetSystemInfo
tools.description: [read-only] Retrieve SAP system identity: system ID (SID), client, logon language, connected user, and an ADT-stack "modern vs legacy" hint. Returns { supported: false } instead of an error when the underlying ADT endpoints are absent on this release.

tools.name: GetTransaction
tools.description: [read-only] Retrieve ABAP transaction (t-code) details — program, screen, authorization object, and transaction type (dialog, report, OO).

tools.name: GetTypeInfo
tools.description: [read-only] Retrieve ABAP type information for domains (DOMA), data elements (DTEL), table types, and structures. Returns field definitions, value ranges, fixed values, and DDIC metadata. A name that is not a domain can answer HTTP 422 (not 404) on the first candidate; 405/406/415/422 now also move on to the next candidate and to the structure fallback, so a structure name reaches the structures lookup (400 does not — it stays a hard error). This note corrects the recorded include_structure_fallback text: the fallback runs after those statuses too, not only after 404/empty. When every candidate fails and any of them answered something other than 404, the error lists which candidate answered which status.

include_structure_fallback.description: When true (default), tries DDIC structure lookup only if type lookup returns 404/empty.

tools.name: GetWhereUsed
tools.description: [read-only] Find where-used references (cross-references, usages, dependencies) for ABAP objects — classes, interfaces, tables, data elements, programs, function modules, etc. Returns list of all referencing objects with their types and packages.

object_type.description: Type of the ABAP object (class, interface, program, table, etc.)

enable_all_types.description: If true, searches in all available object types (Eclipse 'select all' behavior). Default: false (uses SAP default scope)

tools.name: GetObjectsByType
tools.description: [read-only] Retrieves all ABAP objects of a specific type (classes, tables, programs, interfaces, etc.) under a given parent node. Useful for listing all objects of one type within a package or composite object.

tools.name: GrepPackages
tools.description: [read-only] Search ABAP source code for a regex pattern across every object in one or more packages, in a single call — finds matching lines (with optional context) instead of listing then reading objects one by one. Scans CLAS, PROG, INTF, INCL, and FUGR (function group) objects; other repository object types (tables, data elements, domains, etc.) are skipped since they carry no source text. Optionally recurses into subpackages and can filter to specific object types (e.g. ['CLAS','PROG']).

pattern.description: JavaScript regular expression source to search for (e.g. "SELECT\\s+\\*").

context_lines.description: Number of lines of context before/after each match (0-5). Default: 0.

max_results.description: Maximum total matches to return across all objects. Once reached, remaining objects are not fetched. Default: 200.

object_types.description: Optional filter to only scan these object types (e.g. ['CLAS','PROG']). Allowed: CLAS, PROG, INTF, INCL, FUGR. If omitted, all source-bearing types are scanned.

tools.name: RuntimeListDumps
tools.description: [runtime] List ABAP runtime dumps with optional user filter and paging. Returns parsed JSON payload.

user.description: Optional username filter. If omitted, dumps for all users are returned.

top.description: Maximum number of records to return.

tools.name: RuntimeGetDumpById
tools.description: [runtime] Read a specific ABAP runtime dump by dump ID. Returns parsed JSON payload. Use response_mode="both" or "summary" to also include a compact key-facts summary (title, exception, program, line, user, date...).

view.description: Dump view mode: default payload, summary section, or formatted long text.

response_mode.description: Controls what is returned: "payload" (default, legacy) — full parsed dump data only, "summary" — compact key facts only (title, exception, program, line, user, date...), "both" — summary + full payload.

tools.name: RuntimeAnalyzeDump
tools.description: [runtime] Read runtime dump by ID and return compact analysis summary with key fields.

view.description: Dump view mode to analyze: default payload, summary section, or formatted long text.

include_payload.description: Include full parsed payload in response.

tools.name: RuntimeListProfilerTraceFiles
tools.description: [runtime] List ABAP profiler trace files available in ADT runtime. Returns parsed JSON payload.

tools.name: RuntimeGetProfilerTraceData
tools.description: [runtime] Read profiler trace data by trace id/uri: hitlist, statements, or db accesses. Returns parsed JSON payload.

trace_id_or_uri.description: Profiler trace ID or full ADT trace URI.

tools.name: RuntimeAnalyzeProfilerTrace
tools.description: [runtime] Read profiler trace view and return compact analysis summary (totals + top entries).

trace_id_or_uri.description: Profiler trace ID or full trace URI.

top.description: Number of top rows for summary. Default: 10.

tools.name: RuntimeCreateProfilerTraceParameters
tools.description: [runtime] Create ABAP profiler trace parameters and return profilerId (URI) for profiled execution.

description.description: Human-readable trace description.

tools.name: RuntimeRunClassWithProfiling
tools.description: [runtime] Execute ABAP class with profiler enabled and return created profilerId + traceId.

description.description: Profiler trace description.

tools.name: ReloadProfile
tools.description: [system] Reload the active SAP profile from .sapkit/active-profile.txt and reset the cached connection. Called by the sapkit plugin after switching profiles. Returns the newly active alias, host, tier, and readonly status. If the server was started without connection parameters (inspection-only), this CANNOT restore the connection: it returns restartRequired=true and the MCP server must be restarted. If the reloaded profile is on a different deployment axis (onprem/cloud/legacy) than the one this server started on, the server re-registers its tool list for the new axis and sends notifications/tools/list_changed; a client that does not refresh tools on that notification still needs a reconnect (/mcp), which the note says.

tools.name: GetIncludesList
tools.description: [read-only] Recursively discover and list ALL include files within an ABAP program or include. For a class (CLAS/OC) this answers "No includes": class includes (local types, implementations, definitions, macros, tests) are not PROG/I objects. Read them with GetLocalTypes, GetLocalDefinitions, GetLocalMacros or GetLocalTestClass. Those four are exposed on the development tool surface (toolSurface: development), not on readonly.

object_name.description: Name of the ABAP program or include

object_type.description: [read-only] ADT object type (e.g. PROG/P, PROG/I, FUGR, CLAS/OC)

detailed.description: [read-only] If true, returns structured JSON with metadata and raw XML.

timeout.description: [read-only] Timeout in ms for each ADT request.

tools.name: ReadClass
tools.description: [read-only] Read ABAP class source code and metadata (package, responsible, description, etc.). Returns source/main only — local types and the implementations include (CCIMP, where behavior-pool handler classes and other local classes live) are read with GetLocalTypes. GetLocalTypes is exposed on the development tool surface (toolSurface: development), not on readonly.

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) or "inactive".

tools.name: GetClassMethod
tools.description: [read-only] Read the source of a single method implementation (the METHOD...ENDMETHOD block) from an ABAP class, without fetching the entire class source. Use this instead of GetClass/ReadClass when only one method needs inspecting — dramatically smaller than reading the whole class.

method_name.description: Method name to extract (e.g. 'GET_DATA', or for interface method implementations 'ZIF_FOO~BAR').

tools.name: GetLocalDefinitions
tools.description: Retrieve local definitions source code from a class (definitions include). Supports reading active or inactive version.

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) for deployed version, "inactive" for modified but not activated version.

tools.name: GetLocalMacros
tools.description: Retrieve local macros source code from a class (macros include). Supports reading active or inactive version. Note: Macros are supported in older ABAP versions but not in newer ones.

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) for deployed version, "inactive" for modified but not activated version.

tools.name: GetLocalTestClass
tools.description: Retrieve local test class source code from a class. Supports reading active or inactive version.

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) for deployed version, "inactive" for modified but not activated version.

tools.name: GetLocalTypes
tools.description: Retrieve local types source code from a class (implementations include). Supports reading active or inactive version.

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) for deployed version, "inactive" for modified but not activated version.

tools.name: CreateClass
tools.description: Create a new ABAP class in SAP system. Creates the class object in initial state. Use UpdateClass to set source code afterwards.

description.description: Class description (defaults to class_name).

package_name.description: Package name (e.g., ZOK_LAB, $TMP).

transport_request.description: Transport request number (required for transportable packages).

final.description: Mark class as final. Default: false

abstract.description: Mark class as abstract. Default: false

tools.name: UpdateClassMethod
tools.description: Update a single method implementation (METHOD...ENDMETHOD block) of an existing ABAP class without sending the entire class source. Splices the replacement into the current class source, then locks, syntax-checks the full reconstructed class, updates, unlocks, and optionally activates — a broken method never lands.

method_name.description: Method name to replace (e.g. 'GET_DATA', or for interface method implementations 'ZIF_FOO~BAR').

source.description: Full replacement method block. Must start with "METHOD <name>." and end with "ENDMETHOD." (leading/trailing blank lines tolerated); the name must match method_name.

transport_request.description: Transport request number (e.g., E19K905635). Required for transportable packages.

activate.description: Activate after update. Default: false.

tools.name: UpdateLocalTestClass
tools.description: Update a local test class in an ABAP class. Manages lock, check, update, unlock, and optional activation of parent class.

test_class_code.description: Updated source code for the local test class.

transport_request.description: Transport request number (required for transportable objects).

activate_on_update.description: Activate parent class after updating test class. Default: false

tools.name: UpdateLocalTypes
tools.description: Update local types in an ABAP class (implementations include). Manages lock, check, update, unlock, and optional activation.

local_types_code.description: Updated source code for local types.

transport_request.description: Transport request number.

activate_on_update.description: Activate parent class after updating. Default: false

tools.name: GetTableContents
tools.description: [read-only] Retrieve contents (data preview) of an ABAP database table or CDS view. Returns rows of data like SE16/SE16N. There is no filter argument: it always reads every column of the first max_rows rows (default 100) in whatever order the database returns them. For a WHERE clause, selected columns or ordering, use GetSqlQuery.

max_rows.description: Maximum number of rows to retrieve

acknowledge_risk.description: Set to true ONLY after the user has explicitly authorized row extraction from an 'ask'-tier protected table. The approval is logged to stderr for audit. Has no effect on 'deny'-tier tables.

tools.name: ReadTable
tools.description: [read-only] Read ABAP table definition and metadata (package, responsible, description, etc.).

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) or "inactive".

tools.name: CreateTable
tools.description: Create a new ABAP table via the ADT API. Creates the table object in initial state. Use UpdateTable to set DDL code afterwards.

table_name.description: Table name (e.g., ZZ_TEST_TABLE_001). Must follow SAP naming conventions.

description.description: Table description for validation and creation.

package_name.description: Package name (e.g., ZOK_LOCAL, $TMP for local objects)

transport_request.description: Transport request number (e.g., E19K905635). Required for transportable packages.

tools.name: UpdateTable
tools.description: Update DDL source code of an existing ABAP table. Locks the table, uploads new DDL source, and unlocks. Optionally activates after update. Use this to modify existing tables without re-creating metadata.

table_name.description: Table name (e.g., ZZ_TEST_TABLE_001). Table must already exist.

ddl_code.description: Complete DDL source code for a TRANSPARENT TABLE. IMPORTANT — use the MANDT data element for the client key ('key mandt : mandt not null'), NOT 'abap.clnt' (that's CDS-view syntax). Standard SAP tables (MARA, T001, VBAK, …) all use MANDT. tools.name: UpdateDataElement
tools.description:
Update an existing ABAP data element in SAP system.

Workflow:
1. Gets domain info (if type_kind is 'domain') to extract dataType/length/decimals
2. Acquires lock on the data element
3. Updates data element with provided parameters (complete replacement)
4. Unlocks data element
5. Optionally activates data element (default: true)
6. Returns updated data element details

Supported type_kind values:
- domain: Based on ABAP domain (requires type_name = domain name)
- predefinedAbapType: Direct ABAP type (requires data_type, length, decimals)
- refToPredefinedAbapType: Reference to ABAP type (requires data_type, length, decimals)
- refToDictionaryType: Reference to another data element (requires type_name = data element name)
- refToClifType: Reference to class (requires type_name = class name)

Note: All provided parameters completely replace existing values. Field labels are truncated to max lengths (10/20/40/55).

data_element_name.description: Data element name to update (e.g., ZZ_TEST_DTEL_01)

description.description: New data element description

package_name.description: Package name (e.g., ZOK_LOCAL, $TMP for local objects)

transport_request.description: Transport request number (e.g., E19K905635). Required for transportable packages.

type_kind.description: Type kind: domain, predefinedAbapType, refToPredefinedAbapType, refToDictionaryType, refToClifType

type_name.description: Type name: domain name, data element name, or class name (depending on type_kind)

data_type.description: Data type (CHAR, NUMC, etc.) - for predefinedAbapType or refToPredefinedAbapType

activate.description: Activate data element after update (default: true)

tools.name: UpdateDomain
tools.description:
Update an existing ABAP domain in SAP system.

Workflow:
1. Acquires lock on the domain
2. Updates domain with provided parameters (complete replacement)
3. Performs syntax check
4. Unlocks domain
5. Optionally activates domain (default: true)
6. Returns updated domain details

Note: All provided parameters completely replace existing values. Use GetDomain first to see current values if needed.

description.description: New domain description (optional)

package_name.description: Package name (e.g., ZOK_LOCAL, $TMP for local objects)

transport_request.description: Transport request number (e.g., E19K905635). Required for transportable packages.

datatype.description: Data type: CHAR, NUMC, DATS, TIMS, DEC, INT1, INT2, INT4, INT8, CURR, QUAN, etc.

decimals.description: Decimal places (for DEC, CURR, QUAN types)

conversion_exit.description: Conversion exit routine name (without CONVERSION_EXIT_ prefix)

value_table.description: Value table name for foreign key relationship

activate.description: Activate domain after update (default: true)

text.description: Description text for the fixed value

tools.name: GetCallGraph
tools.description: [read-only] Build a call-relationship graph (callers and/or callees) for an ABAP object via server-side breadth-first traversal — replaces repeated round-trips of GetWhereUsed by expanding discovered nodes automatically up to a bounded depth and node count. Static analysis only: dynamic calls, BAdI dispatch, and other runtime-only wiring are not captured.

function_group.description: Function group name — required only when object_type is FUNC (function modules are addressed as GROUP|NAME).

direction.description: 'callers' = who uses the root (default), 'callees' = what the root calls, 'both' = both traversals merged into one graph.

depth.description: Max BFS depth from the root (1-4). Default 2.

max_nodes.description: Global cap on total nodes in the returned graph (max 300). Default 100.

custom_only.description: When true (default), only Z*/Y*//NAMESPACE/ custom objects are expanded further during traversal — standard SAP objects still appear as leaf nodes but are not traversed past. The root is always expanded regardless of this flag.

node_id.description: Optional node ID (default: "0000" for root). Use to fetch child nodes.

session_id.description: Session ID from GetSession. If not provided, a new session will be created.

session_state.description: Session state from GetSession (cookies, csrf_token, cookie_store). Required if session_id is provided.

tools.name: GetObjectStructureLow
tools.description: [low-level] Retrieve ADT object structure as compact JSON tree. Returns XML response with object structure tree. Can use session_id and session_state from GetSession to maintain the same session.

session_id.description: Session ID from GetSession. If not provided, a new session will be created.

session_state.description: Session state from GetSession (cookies, csrf_token, cookie_store). Required if session_id is provided.

tools.name: ReadPackage
tools.description: [read-only] Read ABAP package definition and metadata (super-package, responsible, description, etc.). A package that does not exist still answers success: true with metadata: null — null metadata means the package is absent, not that it exists without attributes. GetPackage returns HTTP 400 for the same missing package; prefer it when the question is whether the package exists at all.

package_name.description: Package name (e.g., Z_MY_PACKAGE).

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) or "inactive".

description.description: Package description. If not provided, package_name will be used.

software_component.description: Software component (e.g., HOME, ZLOCAL). If not provided, SAP will set a default (typically ZLOCAL for local packages).

record_changes.description: Enable change recording for the package. Required for transportable packages. Default: false.
